Security

Committed to security, privacy and responsible data handling.

A clear overview of how Faalak's AI systems handle client and caller data, where safeguards apply, and what documentation is available.

SOC 2 Type II

Our New Jersey data-center provider reports SOC 2 Type II controls for its facility infrastructure. This is a provider certification, not a Faalak certification.

ISO 27001

The hosting facility provider also reports ISO 27001 certification for its infrastructure. Ask us for provider documentation and scope details.

Controlled access

Administrative access is limited to designated team members. Developer access is restricted to the code and configuration needed for maintenance.

Encrypted connections

Encrypted connections are part of Faalak's operational security practices for protecting data in transit between systems.

Regular backups

Regular backups support the in-house CRM and lead database. Specific retention and recovery requirements should be agreed before onboarding.

Privacy documentation

Request a Data Processing Agreement, NDA, business registration details, and available provider security documentation before onboarding.

About Faalak

1. Who Builds and Owns the System

Faalak's automation, CRM, and integration layer is built and owned in-house - it is not a resold or white-labeled product. Faalak is a registered business, and incorporation documents and GST registration are available on request.

How information moves

2. Data Flow

LayerProviderRole
TelephonyTwilioCall routing, phone number provisioning, WhatsApp message delivery
Voice AIRetell AISpeech-to-text / text-to-speech, conversation handling, call recording and transcript storage
Language modelOpenAIConversation understanding and response generation
CRM & automationFaalak (in-house)Lead storage, business logic, and dashboard - fully built and controlled by Faalak

3. Where Data Is Hosted

Twilio, Retell AI, and OpenAI each host their portion of the pipeline on their own managed cloud infrastructure in the United States, and each maintains its own published security and compliance program.

Faalak's in-house CRM and lead database are hosted at InterServer's New Jersey data center (Jersey City - JC1). The service providers listed in the data-flow table may process data as part of delivering the system; no other processors are identified in the described pipeline.

InterServer's New Jersey data center facilities hold SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications for their physical infrastructure. Faalak maintains its own operational security practices - including access control, encrypted connections, and regular backups - at the server and application level.

4. Who Has Access

Faalak's founder has full administrative access to the CRM and hosting infrastructure. Faalak's developer has access limited to code and configuration needed to build and maintain the system, under a signed confidentiality agreement. No data is sold, shared, or used outside delivering the client's service.

5. Compliance

Twilio, OpenAI, and Retell AI each publish their own security and compliance documentation (including SOC 2 reporting) - available on request. Faalak can provide a signed NDA and/or Data Processing Agreement (DPA) prior to onboarding.

6. Questions

Faalak is happy to provide any of the above in writing, along with proof of business registration or a signed NDA/DPA, on request.

7. Scope and regulated data

SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 references on this page apply to the hosting provider's data-center infrastructure, not to an independent Faalak certification. Compliance obligations depend on the services, configuration, contracts, and data involved. If your use case involves health, financial, or other regulated information, contact Faalak before sharing that data so the applicable safeguards and provider terms can be reviewed.
